technical_depth.description: Accuracy of technical terms, correctness of algorithmic complexity, and grasp of foundational mechanics.

star_structure.description: Adherence to Situation, Task, Action, and Result framing with clear context and measurable outcomes.

clarity_fluency.description: Sentence structure, readability, absence of excessive filler words (um, uh, like), and optimal speech pace (120-160 WPM).

relevance_keywords.description: Coverage of expected domain terminology and addressing the core prompt directly.

sentiment_confidence.description: Tone of confidence, professional assertiveness, and constructive problem-solving mindset.

star_definitions.Situation: Sets the scene, explains the background context, company, project, or problem environment.
star_definitions.Task: Defines the specific responsibility, objective, challenge, or expectation assigned to the candidate.
star_definitions.Action: Explains the concrete actions, strategies, technical tools, leadership, and steps taken by the candidate.
star_definitions.Result: Quantifies the outcome, metrics improved, business value delivered, lessons learned, and team impact.
